title: Finding — Valence: 3 models live (WESAD vs EEVR vs CASE)

options.content:
**Three valence models, same 33-feature PPG extractor, running live on YOUR watch signal in parallel.** Each predicts `valence_z` ∈ [-1, +1] (>0 = positive). Observed-only — none feeds the watch verdict.

| Model | What it learned | LOSO (arousal-matched) | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| **WESAD** | stress vs amusement | '82%' | **arousal in disguise** — SHAP shows it leans on mean HR, not valence |
| **EEVR** | VR high-arousal HV vs LV | **56%** | **chance** — VR design-truth carries no cross-subject valence in PPG |
| **CASE** | lived joystick HV vs LV, arousal held constant | **~58%** (p=0.014) | **real but weak** — true valence signal, driven by HRV LF/HF balance |

**How to read the chart:** when the three lines AGREE, the window has a strong, unambiguous affect (all models pick it up). When they DIVERGE, the signal is weak and valence is unreliable — exactly the low-SNR regime where PPG valence fails. This divergence IS the thesis result: valence from wrist PPG is only separable at strong, lived induction, and even then modest (~58%).

panels.title: valence_z — WESAD vs EEVR vs CASE (live, same signal). Agreement = strong affect; divergence = unreliable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, valence_z AS "WESAD (arousal-proxy)" FROM biofizic_legacy_valence_wesad WHERE valence_z IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, valence_z AS "EEVR (chance)" FROM biofizic_legacy_valence_eevr WHERE valence_z IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, valence_z AS "CASE (real, weak)" FROM biofizic_legacy_valence_case WHERE valence_z IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Model agreement — std-dev across the 3 valence_z (low = models agree = trustworthy; high = divergent = unreliable)

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.time, abs(w.valence_z - c.valence_z) AS "|WESAD - CASE|" FROM biofizic_legacy_valence_wesad w JOIN biofizic_legacy_valence_case c ON w.time = c.time WHERE w.valence_z IS NOT NULL AND c.valence_z IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(w.time) ORDER BY w.time
